meaning: Translate one immutable checked DomainSpec graph and its explicit reconciled bindings into one deterministic Cargo workspace whose native Rust modules realize every selected metatype without reparsing authored source or trusting generated descriptors as meaning.

native_forms.Entity: private-field immutable snapshot plus validated factory; manual PartialEq, Eq and Hash over declared identity only
native_forms.Value Object: private-field immutable value plus validated factory; PartialEq, Eq and Hash over the complete normalized tuple
native_forms.Enum: unit native enum with Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Eq and Hash, or owned algebraic sum enum with complete payload equality and hash
native_forms.Rule: pure boolean function over borrowed inputs
native_forms.Calculation: pure function with checked UInt64 arithmetic and explicit Result failures
native_forms.Query: read-only async trait dependency plus result-consuming function
native_forms.Mapping: pure function over explicit inputs; no hidden Calculation or read
native_forms.Policy: pure function selecting a declared target identifier from declared Rule results
native_forms.Event: owned immutable occurrence struct created from explicit inputs
native_forms.Operation: async function with borrowed inputs, declared guards, one explicit atomic port call and explicit outcome
native_forms.State Machine: state and trigger enums plus exhaustive transition function returning output intents without executing them
native_forms.Workflow: async occurrence-aware orchestration over explicit Operation providers, preserving outcome and recovery intent semantics
native_forms.Interface: public contract structs and async trait boundary; no generated transport server

type_algebra.sum: native enum with exact discriminant and owned payload

ownership: Pure observers borrow immutable inputs. Constructed domain values, results, events and returned outcomes own their data. Clones are emitted only at an explicit owned-output boundary and retain the same qualified native type.
errors: Generation rejects stale or forged checked inputs, unsupported contracts, identifier or module collisions, unsafe numeric narrowing, missing exact bindings and conflicting planned bytes. Native declared failures use explicit Result or outcome enums rather than panic.
module_wiring: One checked DomainSpec project is one Cargo library crate. Role paths remain under src/domain or src/application. Collision-free length-prefixed module identifiers retain both feature and node identity, while exact imports are derived from checked graph references. Generated mod.rs, lib.rs and Cargo.toml files are deterministic support artifacts and cannot redefine a concept.
verification: Every cell requires independent native surface observation, Cargo compilation, semantic execution and applicable negative or compile-fail controls. The complete project requires exact 13-of-13 accounting; catalogue presence is insufficient.
effects: Planning is pure. Native verification writes only a new private owned temporary workspace, executes the configured Cargo toolchain there and removes exactly that workspace. Publication remains a separate explicit effect.
compatibility: The existing architecture.rust-strict unit Enum protocol remains unchanged. Payload-bearing typed-sum declarations use the additive rust.owned-algebraic-sum/v1-candidate protocol; they do not alter or masquerade as the unit Enum protocol. Existing legacy Rust node renderers and CLI behavior remain available unless the reconciled Rust selection is explicit.
non_effects: No default cutover, source mutation, relationship invention, persistence, provider installation, admission, release or publication.
